name: Vashti
bio: Vashti was queen to King Ahasuerus of Persia. While the king held a lavish banquet for his nobles, Vashti hosted a separate feast for the women. On the seventh day, when the drunken king summoned her to display her beauty before his guests, she refused to come. Furious, Ahasuerus took his advisor Memucan's counsel that her defiance would encourage wives everywhere to despise their husbands, and issued an irrevocable decree deposing her as queen and barring her from his presence, opening the way for a new queen to be chosen (Esther 1:9-22).
